sources.title: Ethnographic zones – Museum of the Romanian Peasant
sources.excerpt: Located in the central part of the Apuseni Mountains, in the Arieș river basin. Belongs to Alba and Cluj counties. Representative villages: Arieșeni, Gârda de Sus, Avram Iancu, Bistra, Albac, Lupșa, Sălciua, Scărișoara.
